# Dependency lock provenance

The lockfile records the recursive Depends/Imports/LinkingTo closure of netmeta, metafor and stringi from the actual installed analysis library. Base R packages are supplied by R 4.4.0; 66 non-base package versions are pinned. Package records were assembled from installed package metadata on 2026-11-18, not recovered from a historical renv snapshot and not generated by a fresh renv snapshot invocation. No package-content hashes were invented. CRAN repository records let renv retrieve the recorded versions.

The local numerical rerun reused these installed packages. A fresh internet restore and the GitHub/Linux workflow have not been run in this session. Some installed packages emit built-under-R-4.4.1 notices on R 4.4.0; numerical comparisons and independent package checks still passed. Exact package versions are in package_versions.csv.
